theme: Community garden committee: decisions, corrections, retractions and conditional changes

messages.author: u-marisol
messages.text: Hi all! Proposal for the spring work day: Saturday 12 April, 9am, meeting at the north beds.

messages.author: u-teodor
messages.text: Works for me. Are we getting compost this year?

messages.author: u-annika
messages.text: Yes. Decided on last night's call: 3 cubic metres from Fernhill Supply.

messages.author: u-bram
messages.text: Small correction: we agreed 4 cubic metres, not 3. Still Fernhill Supply.

messages.author: u-annika
messages.text: Bram's right, 4 it is.

messages.author: u-quinn
messages.text: If it rains on the 12th we move to the tool shed and do seed sorting instead.

messages.author: u-marisol
messages.text: Agreed, that's the rain plan.

messages.author: u-teodor
messages.text: Thinking out loud: maybe we could add a second water butt by the herb spiral?

messages.author: u-annika
messages.text: Maybe. Depends on the budget, let's revisit in May.

messages.author: u-bram
messages.text: 9am is early for families with kids. Could we start at 10am?

messages.author: u-marisol
messages.text: Fine by me. New plan: Saturday 12 April, 10am start, north beds.

messages.author: u-ines
messages.text: Quick update from me: I repainted all the plot number signs this week.

messages.author: u-teodor
messages.text: I'll bring my wheelbarrow and two spades on the day.

messages.author: u-annika
messages.text: FYI the gate code changes to 4471 from 1 April.

messages.author: u-quinn
messages.text: Fernhill says delivery goes to the north gate. If the roadworks are still blocking it, they'll drop the compost at the south car park.

messages.author: u-marisol
messages.text: If fewer than 6 people sign up, we'll postpone the work day to the 19th.

messages.author: u-ines
messages.text: I've signed up. Who's doing the tool safety talk this year?

messages.author: u-teodor
messages.text: Bad news: my wheelbarrow has a flat tyre, so I can't bring it. Spades still coming.

messages.author: u-bram
messages.text: No problem, I'll bring my wheelbarrow instead.

messages.author: u-annika
messages.text: Retraction: ignore my gate code message. The lock company postponed, so the code stays 2580 for now.

messages.author: u-quinn
messages.text: Walked past on Friday, roadworks are still there. So the compost drop is at the south car park.

messages.author: u-marisol
messages.text: Thanks Quinn. I'll put a sign up there.

messages.author: u-ines
messages.text: Instead of buying new gloves, I'll ask the library swap shelf if they have spares.

messages.author: u-bram
messages.text: Can someone remind me what we're doing if the weather is bad?

messages.author: u-quinn
messages.text: Tool shed, seed sorting. See my message from earlier.

messages.author: u-teodor
messages.text: See you all at 10 on the 12th.

state.note: s1m11 restates date and place and changes 9am to 10am. s1m10 is only a request, not a decision, so it is not paired. The rain plan (s1m06) and the postponement rule (s1m16) are conditionals that were never triggered, so neither supersedes s1m11.
One-detail correction: quantity 3 -> 4, supplier unchanged. s1m05 only confirms s1m04 and is not paired separately.

Conditional change that WAS triggered: roadworks still blocking, so the default north gate drop is replaced by the south car park. s1m15 remains the source of the rule and is acceptable supporting evidence.
Explicit retraction by the same author; code stays 2580.

Teodor withdraws only the wheelbarrow (spades still coming, restated in s1m18). Bram takes over the wheelbarrow in s1m19, which is an ownership handover, additive, not a pair. Trap: s1m19 and s1m23 use 'instead'; s1m23 is not a correction of anything. s1m12 uses 'update' without correcting anything. s1m08/s1m09 water butt is only a maybe.

questions.question: What time does the spring work day start?
questions.goldAnswer: It starts at 10am on Saturday 12 April at the north beds.
questions.note: s1m11 replaced the original 9am proposal. s1m10 was only a request and also contains '9am', so it is neither required nor allowed.

questions.question: Are we getting 3 cubic metres of compost?
questions.goldAnswer: No. Bram corrected it to 4 cubic metres, still from Fernhill Supply.

questions.question: Is the gate code changing to 4471?
questions.goldAnswer: No. Annika retracted that; the lock company postponed and the code stays 2580 for now.

questions.question: Where will the compost be dropped off?
questions.goldAnswer: At the south car park, because the roadworks were still blocking the north gate.
questions.note: The conditional in s1m15 was triggered by s1m21. s1m15 is allowed because it states the rule being applied.

questions.question: Who is bringing a wheelbarrow to the work day?
questions.goldAnswer: Bram. Teodor withdrew his wheelbarrow because of a flat tyre but is still bringing spades.
questions.note: Offer withdrawn (s1m18) and taken over by someone else (s1m19).

questions.question: Have we confirmed seed sorting in the tool shed on the 12th?
questions.goldAnswer: No. Tool shed and seed sorting is only the rain plan; nobody confirmed rain, so the main plan is still the north beds at 10am.
questions.note: Conditional whose condition is never confirmed.

questions.question: Has the work day been postponed to the 19th?
questions.goldAnswer: No. The 19th was only a fallback if fewer than 6 people sign up, and nobody said that happened.
questions.note: Untriggered conditional; no sign-up count was reported.

questions.question: Did the committee decide to buy a second water butt?
questions.goldAnswer: No. It was only a maybe; Annika said it depends on the budget and to revisit in May.

questions.question: Who is giving the tool safety talk this year?
questions.goldAnswer: Unknown. Ines asked, but nobody answered in the chat.

questions.question: How much did the compost order cost?
questions.goldAnswer: Unknown. The price of the compost was never mentioned in the chat.

deletionProbe.question: What is the gate code right now?
